title: Shopping
description: Buy things, ask the price, and push back on it.

questions.sentence: Eitar dam kiman?
options: Eitar dam posas taka.
Eitar rong ronga.
Eito mor mona.
questions.correctAnswer: Eitar dam posas taka.
questions.translatedSentence: This one costs fifty rupees.

questions.sentence: Ei gamosakhonor dam kiman?
options: How much is this gamosa?
Where can I buy a gamosa?
This gamosa is very nice.
questions.correctAnswer: How much is this gamosa?

questions.sentence: Apuni ki kinibo bisare?
options: Mok eta gamosa lage.
Moi dokanot kaam koru.
Mor ghor iyate ase.
questions.correctAnswer: Mok eta gamosa lage.
questions.translatedSentence: I need a gamosa.

questions.sentence: Ei saahor dam bis taka.
options: This tea costs twenty rupees.
This tea is very hot.
I drink tea every day.
questions.correctAnswer: This tea costs twenty rupees.

questions.sentence: Ei jutajorar dam kiman?
options: Ei jutajorar dam exo taka.
Ei juta bor dhuniya.
Moi nutun juta kinim.
questions.correctAnswer: Ei jutajorar dam exo taka.
questions.translatedSentence: This pair of shoes costs a hundred rupees.

questions.sentence: Ei dokanor jinis bor sosta.
options: The things in this shop are very cheap.
The things in this shop are very expensive.
This shop is very big.
questions.correctAnswer: The things in this shop are very cheap.

questions.sentence: Kiman hol?
options: Xathi taka hol.
Moi bhal ase.
Dokan bondho hol.
questions.correctAnswer: Xathi taka hol.
questions.translatedSentence: It comes to sixty rupees.

questions.sentence: Moi eito lom.
options: I will take this one.
I will not take this one.
I am looking at this one.
questions.correctAnswer: I will take this one.

questions.sentence: Ei dam beshi neki?
options: Nai, dam thik ase.
Hoi, dokan bor dur.
Nai, moi Jorhatot thako.
questions.correctAnswer: Nai, dam thik ase.
questions.translatedSentence: No, the price is fine.

questions.sentence: Apunak ki lage?
options: Mok duta gamosa lage.
Mok apunar dokan bhal lage.
Moi etiya ghoroloi jam.
questions.correctAnswer: Mok duta gamosa lage.
questions.translatedSentence: I need two gamosas.

questions.sentence: Apunar dokanot saah pata ase ne?
options: Do you have tea leaves in your shop?
Is your shop open now?
Do you drink tea in the shop?
questions.correctAnswer: Do you have tea leaves in your shop?

questions.sentence: Apunar dokanot pitha ase ne?
options: Hoi, til pitha aru ghila pitha ase.
Hoi, moi pitha bonabo jano.
Nai, moi pitha nakhao.
questions.correctAnswer: Hoi, til pitha aru ghila pitha ase.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, we have til pitha and ghila pitha.

questions.sentence: Mok olop bilahi aru piyaj lage.
options: I need some tomatoes and onions.
I do not need tomatoes or onions.
Are the tomatoes and onions fresh?
questions.correctAnswer: I need some tomatoes and onions.

questions.sentence: Aru eku lage neki?
options: Nai, eitukei hol.
Hoi, dam bor beshi.
Nai, dokan bondho ase.
questions.correctAnswer: Nai, eitukei hol.
questions.translatedSentence: No, that is all.

questions.sentence: Xei nila sadorkhon mok dekhuwaok.
options: Please show me that blue sador.
Please keep that blue sador for me.
I really like that blue sador.
questions.correctAnswer: Please show me that blue sador.

questions.sentence: Apuni gamosa bisari ase neki?
options: Hoi, mor deutar babe eta lage.
Nai, moi gamosa bikri koru.
Hoi, mor gamosa harai gol.
questions.correctAnswer: Hoi, mor deutar babe eta lage.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I need one for my father.

questions.sentence: Ei dokanot mas aru xaak pua jai ne?
options: Can I get fish and greens in this shop?
Is the fish in this shop fresh?
Where do you buy your fish and greens?
questions.correctAnswer: Can I get fish and greens in this shop?

questions.sentence: Ei sadorkhon apunar babe neki?
options: Nai, eikhon mor mar babe.
Hoi, moi sador nipindho.
Nai, moi sador bikri koru.
questions.correctAnswer: Nai, eikhon mor mar babe.
questions.translatedSentence: No, this one is for my mother.

questions.sentence: Ei sadorkhonor dam pasxo taka.
options: Dam bor beshi, olop kom korok.
Thik ase, moi tinikhon lom.
Nai, mok saah pata lage.
questions.correctAnswer: Dam bor beshi, olop kom korok.
questions.translatedSentence: That is too expensive, please bring it down a little.

questions.sentence: Olop kom kori diok, moi apunar niyomiya grahok.
options: Please lower it a little, I am a regular customer of yours.
Please keep it aside, I will come back tomorrow.
Please give me one more, I am a regular customer of yours.
questions.correctAnswer: Please lower it a little, I am a regular customer of yours.

questions.sentence: Tente apuni kiman dibo?
options: Moi tinixo taka dim.
Moi kali ahim.
Moi eito nolom.
questions.correctAnswer: Moi tinixo taka dim.
questions.translatedSentence: I will give three hundred rupees.

questions.sentence: Ei dam mor babe bor beshi hoi gol.
options: This price has turned out to be far too much for me.
This price is quite reasonable for me.
I have already paid too much money for this.
questions.correctAnswer: This price has turned out to be far too much for me.

questions.sentence: Ei damot moi kombo nuwaru.
options: Tente moi beleg dokan eta sam.
Tente moi duta lom.
Tente apuni aru olop dam barhaok.
questions.correctAnswer: Tente moi beleg dokan eta sam.
questions.translatedSentence: Then I will go and look at another shop.

questions.sentence: Xei dokanot ekei jinis tatokoi sosta pua jai.
options: The same thing is available cheaper in that shop.
That shop sells better things than this one.
I bought the same thing in that shop.
questions.correctAnswer: The same thing is available cheaper in that shop.

questions.sentence: Moi duxo taka dim, hobo ne?
options: Nai, aru tirix taka diok.
Hoi, dam bor beshi hoise.
Nai, moi taka nolom.
questions.correctAnswer: Nai, aru tirix taka diok.
questions.translatedSentence: No, please give thirty rupees more.

questions.sentence: Jodi apuni olop kom kore, moi duta lom.
options: If you bring the price down a little, I will take two.
If you have two of them, I will buy one.
Even though the price is high, I will take two.
questions.correctAnswer: If you bring the price down a little, I will take two.

questions.sentence: Tente xex dam kiman?
options: Xex dam sarixo taka, tatokoi kom nohobo.
Xex dam mor bondhue dise.
Xex dam moi kali kinisilo.
questions.correctAnswer: Xex dam sarixo taka, tatokoi kom nohobo.
questions.translatedSentence: The final price is four hundred rupees, it will not be less than that.

questions.sentence: Apunak kiman kilo alu lage?
options: Mok tini kilo alu lage.
Alur dam bor kom.
Moi alu bhal nepao.
questions.correctAnswer: Mok tini kilo alu lage.
questions.translatedSentence: I need three kilos of potatoes.

questions.sentence: Mok adha kilo mas aru dui kilo alu lage.
options: I need half a kilo of fish and two kilos of potatoes.
I need two kilos of fish and half a kilo of potatoes.
Do you have half a kilo of fish and some potatoes?
questions.correctAnswer: I need half a kilo of fish and two kilos of potatoes.

questions.sentence: Ei jamakhon tomar babe dangor neki?
options: Hoi, mok tatokoi soru eta lage.
Hoi, moi jama nipindho.
Nai, jamar dam beshi.
questions.correctAnswer: Hoi, mok tatokoi soru eta lage.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I need one smaller than this.

questions.sentence: Ei jutajora mor bhorir babe soru hoise.
options: This pair of shoes is too small for my feet.
This pair of shoes is too big for my feet.
This pair of shoes is very cheap for me.
questions.correctAnswer: This pair of shoes is too small for my feet.

questions.sentence: Apuni kiman ta pitha lobo?
options: Mok pasta pitha diok.
Pitha bor gorom hoi ase.
Moi pitha bonabo nejano.
questions.correctAnswer: Mok pasta pitha diok.
questions.translatedSentence: Please give me five pithas.

questions.sentence: Majholi mapor sador thakile mok eta diok.
options: If you have a medium size sador, please give me one.
If this sador is too big, please show me another one.
Please give me the biggest sador that you have.
questions.correctAnswer: If you have a medium size sador, please give me one.

questions.sentence: Apunak dangor mona lage ne soru?
options: Mok eta dangor mona lage.
Mona tur dam bor beshi.
Moi ghoror pora mona anisu.
questions.correctAnswer: Mok eta dangor mona lage.
questions.translatedSentence: I need a big bag.

questions.sentence: Ek kilo saah patar dam kiman poribo?
options: How much will one kilo of tea leaves come to?
How many kilos of tea leaves do you want?
Where do these tea leaves come from?
questions.correctAnswer: How much will one kilo of tea leaves come to?

questions.sentence: Etiya xob milai kiman hol?
options: Xob milai duxo posas taka hol.
Xob milai tini kilo hol.
Etiya dokan bondho hol.
questions.correctAnswer: Xob milai duxo posas taka hol.
questions.translatedSentence: Altogether it comes to two hundred and fifty rupees.

questions.sentence: Apuni nogode dibo ne cardere dibo?
options: Moi nogode dim.
Moi kali dim.
Moi taka nolom.
questions.correctAnswer: Moi nogode dim.
questions.translatedSentence: I will pay in cash.

questions.sentence: Mor ocorot exo takar note ase, bhangti ase ne?
options: I have a hundred rupee note, do you have change?
I do not have a hundred rupees, can I pay tomorrow?
I have some change, do you need a hundred rupee note?
questions.correctAnswer: I have a hundred rupee note, do you have change?

questions.sentence: Mor ocorot etiya bhangti nai, olop apekha korok.
options: Thik ase, moi apekha korim.
Thik ase, moi taka nidiu.
Nai, mok bhangti nalage.
questions.correctAnswer: Thik ase, moi apekha korim.
questions.translatedSentence: That is fine, I will wait.

questions.sentence: Anugroh kori mok rosid khon diok.
options: Please give me the receipt.
Please write the price down for me.
Please keep the receipt with you.
questions.correctAnswer: Please give me the receipt.

questions.sentence: Apunak polythene mona eta lage ne?
options: Hoi, eta dangor mona diok.
Nai, moi mona bikri koru.
Hoi, mona tur rong bhal.
questions.correctAnswer: Hoi, eta dangor mona diok.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, please give me a big bag.

questions.sentence: Moi phonere taka dibo paru ne?
options: Can I pay with my phone?
Can I call you on the phone?
Can I buy a phone here?
questions.correctAnswer: Can I pay with my phone?

questions.sentence: Apuni aru bis taka dibo lagibo.
options: Ei lok, bis takar note eta.
Nai, moi xob taka dilo.
Hoi, moi bis taka pao.
questions.correctAnswer: Ei lok, bis takar note eta.
questions.translatedSentence: Here you are, a twenty rupee note.

questions.sentence: Bhangti nai karone apuni pas taka kom dile o hobo.
options: Since there is no change, it is fine if you give five rupees less.
Since there is no change, please give me five rupees more.
There is no change, so I cannot sell you this.
questions.correctAnswer: Since there is no change, it is fine if you give five rupees less.

questions.sentence: Taka guni sauk, thik ase ne?
options: Hoi, thik ase, dhonyobad.
Nai, moi taka guni nasao.
Hoi, kintu mor ocorot taka nai.
questions.correctAnswer: Hoi, thik ase, dhonyobad.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, it is correct, thank you.

questions.sentence: Moi kali kina jutajora soru hoise, ubhotai dibo paru ne?
options: Hoi, rosid thakile ubhotai dibo paribo.
Nai, ami juta bikri nokoru.
Hoi, kintu apuni kali juta kinisil.
questions.correctAnswer: Hoi, rosid thakile ubhotai dibo paribo.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, if you have the receipt you can return it.

questions.sentence: Ei sadorkhon dhuwar pisot rong eri gol, seye moi ubhotai dibo bisaro.
options: The colour came off this sador after washing, so I want to return it.
This sador tore while I was washing it, so I want another one.
I washed this sador yesterday, but the colour is still bright.
questions.correctAnswer: The colour came off this sador after washing, so I want to return it.

questions.sentence: Apuni aan eta lobo ne taka ubhotai lobo?
options: Moi taka ubhotai lom, kiyono mok etiya eku nalage.
Moi eito ubhotai nidiu, kiyono dam bor beshi.
Moi kali aru duta kinim, kiyono dam bor kom.
questions.correctAnswer: Moi taka ubhotai lom, kiyono mok etiya eku nalage.
questions.translatedSentence: I will take the money back, because I do not need anything now.

questions.sentence: Ei phonetu kalir pora bhalke kaam kora nai.
options: This phone has not been working properly since yesterday.
This phone stopped working the day I bought it.
I have not used this phone since yesterday.
questions.correctAnswer: This phone has not been working properly since yesterday.

questions.sentence: Tumi ei dokanoloi kiyo bare bare aha?
options: Kiyono iyat jinis bhal aru dam o kom.
Kiyono mor ghor iyar pora bor dur.
Kiyono moi iyat eku napao.
questions.correctAnswer: Kiyono iyat jinis bhal aru dam o kom.
questions.translatedSentence: Because the things here are good and the prices are low too.

questions.sentence: Xei dokanot dam kom, kintu iyar jinis bhal.
options: That shop is cheaper, but the things here are better.
That shop is cheaper, and the things there are better too.
This shop is cheaper, but that shop is closer.
questions.correctAnswer: That shop is cheaper, but the things here are better.

questions.sentence: Apunar kiba oxubidha hoise neki?
options: Hoi, ei mona tu prothom dinate bhangi gol.
Nai, moi ei mona tu bhal pao.
Hoi, mona tur dam bor kom asil.
questions.correctAnswer: Hoi, ei mona tu prothom dinate bhangi gol.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, this bag broke on the very first day.

questions.sentence: Jodi apuni ubhotai nolo, moi ei dokanoloi aru nahu.
options: If you do not take it back, I will not come to this shop again.
If you take it back, I will come to this shop again.
Since you did not take it back, I did not come to this shop.
questions.correctAnswer: If you do not take it back, I will not come to this shop again.

questions.sentence: Apunar oviyog ami likhi lolo, aru kiba kobo lage ne?
options: Nai, eitukei, xohai koraat dhonyobad.
Hoi, moi aru duta mona lom.
Nai, moi eku oviyog kora nai.
questions.correctAnswer: Nai, eitukei, xohai koraat dhonyobad.
questions.translatedSentence: No, that is all, thank you for the help.
